text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Debut day has finally arrived.
As for Katsuragi Ace—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Just a little, yeah. But I'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I trained like crazy for today.
All that's left is to hit them with everything I've got...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh—
I'm startin' to get real excited now!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —I'll go out there and show everything you've taught me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So stand tall and be confident, Trainer!
Just keep your eyes on my run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—As she said this, Katsuragi Ace raised her right hand.
Understanding her intent, I raised my right hand as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—*Clap!* The sound of a high five
resonated satisfyingly through the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(—So this is the atmosphere of the real race paddock...!
Standing here in person really is totally different...!)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. It's my debut race, after all.
It's fine to just take it easy at first.
Don't push yourself, don't overdo it...—

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I've made it this far...! Finally...!!
I'm gonna run with everything I've got today~~!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
......I'm so glad Mr. C.B.
isn't here... really...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Seems like everyone's just doing their own thing, huh.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(—Wait, this is no time to be distracted by others!
Focus, focus!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll give it everything I've got.
All of who I am right now, into this debut race!!"
